earned_by.selection_basis: The unchanged T247 graph has six complete routes selected only by the immutable 64-D post-calibration context. Exploratory dependency closure reduced the ORT-optimized graph from 112 nodes to 85-93 nodes for every route, while the last X5 p99 miss requires a sustained 10.496275329846201% compute reduction.

nomenclature.clarification: This is a T247 deployment-validation contract. It does not define or train a T250/T251 policy.

implementation_scope.generated_binary_location: an explicit external output directory under D:/CodexArtifacts; no ONNX binary enters the repository

route_selector.construction: extract the original positive and conditional router MatMul/Add/comparison nodes and their byte-identical initializers into a tiny ONNX graph
route_selector.execution: run once on the frozen final calibration context using the same ONNX Runtime provider before selecting a locomotion session
required_invariants: the original t162 and t156 bounded-positive predicates agree
tail and bounded-positive are mutually exclusive
the original t149 and t143 conditional predicates agree
exactly one of lower, positive, or tail is selected

allowed_graph_transform: for lower and positive routes, bypass the home-negative low-command rewrite; for tail routes retain the exact-command-dependent rewrite while eliminating the now-constant tail conjunction
for cond0 bypass the t149 command cap and conditional negative adapter; for cond1 select them
for lower and tail routes bypass the t162 positive command rewrite; for positive routes retain its moving-command predicate while eliminating the now-constant context conjunction
select the route-determined conditional adapter and mechanics-bias source without changing any surviving arithmetic
perform backward dead-code elimination from the unchanged three policy outputs while preserving all four input declarations and their metadata
remove only initializers not referenced by the retained dependency closure
forbidden_graph_transform: change, quantize, fuse manually, transpose, round, rename, or replace any retained initializer value
change a surviving arithmetic operator, tensor dtype, tensor shape, graph input, graph output, action value, recurrent state value, or execution order dependency
classify calibration context with a reimplemented NumPy threshold instead of the extracted original router graph
specialize only the observed lower-cond0 configuration
modify the calibrator, observation assembly, P30 observer, target path, action semantics, policy weights, or production runtime

threshold_neighborhoods: positive score immediately below, at-or-first-above, and above zero
positive score immediately below, at-or-first-above, and above the original upper bound
conditional score immediately below, at-or-first-above, and above zero

semantic_cpu_contract.failure_boundary: Any selector mismatch, initializer mismatch, ABI mismatch, output-bit mismatch, recurrent divergence, nonfinite value, route omission, wrong handoff count, or measured rate excess closes the mechanism before timing.

local_timing_contract.order: alternate predecessor-first and specialized-first for each paired sample
local_timing_contract.input_bank: cycle deterministic valid graph inputs generated by the exact T247 host; use the full 2048-tick actual locomotion bank for lower-cond0 and route-valid deterministic banks for the other five variants
